facts.business: LCC Infotech Limited is engaged in the business of information technology and has entered into a new line of business for purchase and production of films, and proposes to carry on the business of manufacturing, processing, and dealing in all kinds of salt and salt-based products.

auditor.name: M/s. Sarang Shivajirao Chavan and Associates

key_risks: The Company advanced ₹4,012.75 lakhs during the year to Omega Interactive Technologies Limited under a composite agreement for purchase of a completed film and production of ten further films, aggregating a commercial commitment of ₹101 crores. This represents a new and significant line of business for the Company and a substantial proportion of its total assets.
facts.related_party_note: The Company has approved existing as well as new material related party transactions with Mr. Shreeram Bagla (Loan availed taken by the Company up to Rs. 500.00 Lakhs) and Mrs. Rachna Suman Shaw (Loan availed taken by the Company up to Rs. 500.00 Lakhs) for the period FY 2025-26 to FY 2029-30.
